title: What It Actually Looks Like to Kill Your Sin Without Losing Yourself
caption:
Scripture doesn't say manage your sin, it says put it to death. But there's a way to fight it that turns into hating the whole man, and that's not the same war.

Guilt says you did wrong. Shame says you are wrong. Only one of those is true, and only one of those actually leads anywhere. Confess it the same day, before it has time to turn into a secret you're managing. Track whether you said no today, not how long the streak is. And let a brother see the fight itself, not just the highlight reel afterward.

Ruthless with the sin. Patient with the man still being built.

#faith #sin #godlyman #confession #christianmen
